ExecutiveSummary: HealthConnect AI is a comprehensive digital platform designed to enhance patient-doctor interactions through advanced AI technologies. This Progressive Web App (PWA) aims to streamline the onboarding process, facilitate secure communication, and provide real-time insights and summaries during consultations. The platform ensures data security and compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25, making it a reliable and user-friendly solution for both patients and doctors.
Background: In today's fast-paced world, efficient and secure communication between patients and doctors is crucial. Traditional methods often fall short in providing timely and accurate information, leading to delays in diagnosis and treatment. HealthConnect AI addresses these challenges by leveraging AI to enhance patient-doctor interactions, streamline data management, and provide valuable insights. This platform is designed to be accessible on various devices, ensuring convenience and ease of use for all users.
Objectives: Enhance patient-doctor communication through AI-driven interactions.
Ensure secure and efficient data management and storage.
Provide real-time insights and summaries during consultations.
Comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 for data security and privacy.
Create a user-friendly interface accessible on multiple devices.
Scope: The scope of HealthConnect AI includes developing a Progressive Web App (PWA) for both patients and doctors, focusing on user authentication, patient-doctor interactions, AI integration, and data management. The software will be accessible on mobile devices (Android and iOS) and web browsers. Key features include user authentication, patient and doctor dashboards, AI-guided onboarding, real-time consultation assistance, and secure data storage. The project will ensure compliance with relevant data security and privacy laws.
Deliverables: Functional PWA for patients and doctors with secure user authentication.
Patient dashboard with AI-guided onboarding, chat interface, and historical data access.
Doctor dashboard with patient management, consultation process, and AI assistance.
Integration of OpenAI APIs for voice-to-text, text-to-voice, and text generation.
Secure data storage and management using MongoDB and AWS hosting.
Email notifications for registration, verification, and report approvals.
Compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 for data security and privacy.

MitigationStrategies: Implement robust encryption for data in transit and at rest using industry-standard algorithms.
Conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities.
Ensure compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 by integrating legal requirements into the development process and maintaining up-to-date documentation.
Optimize AI models and APIs to ensure real-time or near-real-time responses.
Implement fallback mechanisms to handle API rate limits and latency issues, such as caching frequently accessed data.
Conduct extensive testing with various user scenarios to ensure the AI performs reliably and efficiently under different conditions.
Adopt responsive design principles to ensure a seamless user experience across different devices and screen sizes.
Conduct usability testing on both Android and iOS devices, as well as web browsers, to identify and address any compatibility issues.
Implement accessibility features to ensure the platform is usable by individuals with disabilities, including screen reader support and high-contrast modes.

Details.Description: Enable doctors to register and log in with OTP mobile verification and email verification. Allow doctors to manage their profile information, including name, phone number, email, and profile picture.
Provide doctors with a list of patients who have granted access via QR code. Allow doctors to access detailed profiles, including visit and consultation histories, of each patient.

Enable doctors to start a new consultation session by scanning the patient's QR code to link the consultation to the patient. Provide AI assistance during consultations for real-time analysis and summarization. Allow doctors to generate, review, edit, and approve consultation reports, and share approved reports with patients.

Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. Use the AI to retrieve and summarize relevant patient history to aid the doctor during consultations.
Provide a feature for doctors to view a list of patients categorized by flags based on the patients' onboarding responses. This helps doctors prioritize and manage patient care effectively.
Send email notifications to doctors for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. Ensure timely communication of critical updates and actions.
Implement robust access control mechanisms to protect patient data. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.

Enable patients to securely register, log in, and manage their profile information. This includes email and phone OTP verification during registration and the ability to update profile details such as name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

Provide an AI-guided onboarding process where patients can start a new visit, answer dynamic questions based on conversation context, and have their responses stored in a structured format. This process will generate a patient summary that can be viewed by both the patient and the doctor.

Implement a chat interface on the patient dashboard that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses, analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being, and summarize long conversations.

Allow patients to view their past onboarding summaries and consultation histories. This includes providing a tab for onboarding history and another for consultation history, where patients can access detailed reports of their interactions and consultations.

Details.Item: Profile Management and QR Code Access
Details.Description: Enable patients to manage their profile information and generate a QR code that doctors can scan to access the patient's visit and consultation histories. This feature will be available on the patient's profile page.

Send email notifications to patients for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. This ensures that patients are kept informed about their account activities and medical updates.
